title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Ireland's eye care programme in Senegal covers Diourbel, Kaolack, Tambacounda, Kedougou, and Ziguinchor, aiming to reach 843,246 people, including the delivery of 46,322 cataract surgeries. Partnering with the Ministry of Health and Social Action, the programme focuses on equitable access to quality eye health services, especially for women and people with disabilities. Key activities include advocating for eye health financing through systems analysis, developing and disseminating the national eye health strategic plan post-2025, and organising training workshops for health workers on gender and disability inclusion to improve eye care services. The overall aim of the project is to provide eye care services for the blind, and to reduce the prevalence of preventable blindness. In addition, the project aims to reach an equal number of male and female patients according to their eye health needs.
